<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use App\Models\FarmSetting;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Textarea;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Filament\Pages\Page;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Actions;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Form;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;

class FarmSettings extends Page
{
    protected string $view = 'filament.pages.farm-settings';

    protected static ?string $navigationLabel = 'Farm Settings';

    protected static string|\UnitEnum|null $navigationGroup = 'Farm Management';

    protected static \BackedEnum|string|null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-cog-6-tooth';

    protected static ?int $navigationSort = 90;

    protected static ?string $title = 'Farm Settings';

    public ?array $data = [];

    public function mount(): void
    {
        $this->form->fill(
            $this->getRecord()?->attributesToArray()
        );
    }

    public function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema
            ->components([
                Form::make([
                    Section::make('Farm Information')
                        ->description('Manage your farm identity and contact information.')
                        ->schema([
                            TextInput::make('farm_name')
                                ->label('Farm Name')
                                ->required()
                                ->maxLength(255),

                            TextInput::make('owner_name')
                                ->label('Owner Name')
                                ->required()
                                ->maxLength(255),

                            TextInput::make('phone_number')
                                ->label('Phone Number')
                                ->tel()
                                ->regex('/^[0-9+\-\s()]+$/')
                                ->maxLength(20),

                            Textarea::make('address')
                                ->label('Farm Address')
                                ->rows(3),

                            Textarea::make('description')
                                ->label('Farm Description')
                                ->rows(4),
                        ])
                        ->columns(2),

                    Section::make('Regional Settings')
                        ->schema([
                            Select::make('currency')
                                ->label('Currency')
                                ->options([
                                    'BDT' => 'BDT - Bangladeshi Taka',
                                ])
                                ->required(),
                        ]),

                    Section::make('Farm Logo')
                        ->schema([
                            FileUpload::make('farm_logo')
                                ->label('Upload Farm Logo')
                                ->image()
                                ->disk('public')
                                ->directory('farm-logos')
                                ->imageEditor()
                                ->maxSize(2048),
                        ]),
                ])
                    ->livewireSubmitHandler('save')
                    ->footer([
                        Actions::make([
                            Action::make('save')
                                ->label('Save Farm Settings')
                                ->submit('save')
                                ->keyBindings(['mod+s']),
                        ]),
                    ]),
            ])
            ->record($this->getRecord())
            ->statePath('data');
    }

    public function save(): void
    {
        $data = $this->form->getState();

        $record = $this->getRecord() ?? new FarmSetting();

        $record->fill($data);
        $record->save();

        if ($record->wasRecentlyCreated) {
            $this->form->record($record)->saveRelationships();
        }

        Notification::make()
            ->success()
            ->title('Farm settings saved successfully!')
            ->send();
    }

    public function getRecord(): ?FarmSetting
    {
        return FarmSetting::query()->first();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Poultries\Schemas;

use App\Models\Poultry;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Textarea;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;

class PoultryForm
{
    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema
            ->components([
                Section::make('Poultry Information')
                    ->schema([
                        TextInput::make('poultry_code')
                            ->label('Poultry Code')
                            ->default(fn () => 'POU-' . now()->format('Ymd') . '-' . strtoupper(\Illuminate\Support\Str::random(5)))
                            ->required()
                            ->unique(ignoreRecord: true)
                            ->maxLength(50),

                        TextInput::make('name')
                            ->label('Name')
                            ->required()
                            ->maxLength(150),

                        Select::make('type')
                            ->label('Poultry Type')
                            ->options([
                                Poultry::TYPE_CHICKEN => 'Chicken',
                                Poultry::TYPE_ROOSTER => 'Rooster',
                            ])
                            ->required(),

                        TextInput::make('breed')
                            ->label('Breed')
                            ->maxLength(100),
                    ])
                    ->columns(2),

                Section::make('Quantity')
                    ->schema([
                        TextInput::make('initial_quantity')
                            ->label('Initial Quantity')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->integer()
                            ->minValue(1)
                            ->required(),

                        TextInput::make('current_quantity')
                            ->label('Current Quantity')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->disabled()
                            ->dehydrated(false)
                            ->visible(fn (?Poultry $record): bool => $record !== null),
                    ])
                    ->columns(2),

                Section::make('Purchase & Age')
                    ->schema([
                        DatePicker::make('purchase_date')
                            ->label('Purchase Date')
                            ->native(false),

                        TextInput::make('unit_purchase_price')
                            ->label('Unit Purchase Price')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->prefix('à§³')
                            ->minValue(0),

                        DatePicker::make('date_of_birth')
                            ->label('Date of Birth')
                            ->native(false),
                    ])
                    ->columns(3),

                Section::make('Status & Notes')
                    ->schema([
                        Select::make('status')
                            ->label('Status')
                            ->options([
                                Poultry::STATUS_ACTIVE => 'Active',
                                Poultry::STATUS_SOLD => 'Sold',
                                Poultry::STATUS_DECEASED => 'Deceased',
                            ])
                            ->default(Poultry::STATUS_ACTIVE)
                            ->required(),

                        Textarea::make('notes')
                            ->label('Notes')
                            ->rows(3)
                            ->columnSpanFull(),
                    ])
                    ->columns(2),
            ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Poultries\Tables;

use App\Models\Poultry;
use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use Filament\Actions\ViewAction;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Table;

class PoultriesTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('poultry_code')
                    ->label('Poultry Code')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->copyable(),

                TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Name')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('type')
                    ->label('Type')
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => ucfirst($state))
                    ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        Poultry::TYPE_CHICKEN => 'info',
                        Poultry::TYPE_ROOSTER => 'warning',
                        default => 'gray',
                    }),

                TextColumn::make('breed')
                    ->label('Breed')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->placeholder('Not specified'),

                TextColumn::make('initial_quantity')
                    ->label('Initial')
                    ->numeric()
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('current_quantity')
                    ->label('Current Stock')
                    ->numeric()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight('bold'),

                TextColumn::make('unit_purchase_price')
                    ->label('Unit Price')
                    ->money('BDT')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->placeholder('N/A'),

                TextColumn::make('purchase_date')
                    ->label('Purchase Date')
                    ->date('d M Y')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->placeholder('N/A'),

                TextColumn::make('status')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => ucfirst($state))
                    ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        Poultry::STATUS_ACTIVE => 'success',
                        Poultry::STATUS_SOLD => 'info',
                        Poultry::STATUS_DECEASED => 'danger',
                        default => 'gray',
                    }),
            ])
            ->filters([
                SelectFilter::make('type')
                    ->label('Poultry Type')
                    ->options([
                        Poultry::TYPE_CHICKEN => 'Chicken',
                        Poultry::TYPE_ROOSTER => 'Rooster',
                    ]),

                SelectFilter::make('status')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->options([
                        Poultry::STATUS_ACTIVE => 'Active',
                        Poultry::STATUS_SOLD => 'Sold',
                        Poultry::STATUS_DECEASED => 'Deceased',
                    ]),
            ])
            ->recordActions([
                ViewAction::make(),
                EditAction::make(),
            ])
            ->toolbarActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                ]),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc');
    }
}

SOURCE FILE: app\Models\Poultry.php

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class Poultry extends Model
{
    public const TYPE_CHICKEN = 'chicken';

    public const TYPE_ROOSTER = 'rooster';

    public const STATUS_ACTIVE = 'active';

    public const STATUS_SOLD = 'sold';

    public const STATUS_DECEASED = 'deceased';

    protected $fillable = [
        'poultry_code',
        'name',
        'type',
        'breed',
        'initial_quantity',
        'current_quantity',
        'purchase_date',
        'unit_purchase_price',
        'date_of_birth',
        'status',
        'notes',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'initial_quantity' => 'integer',
            'current_quantity' => 'integer',
            'purchase_date' => 'date',
            'date_of_birth' => 'date',
            'unit_purchase_price' => 'decimal:2',
        ];
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::creating(function (Poultry $poultry): void {
            if (blank($poultry->poultry_code)) {
                do {
                    $code = 'POU-' . now()->format('Ymd') . '-' . Str::upper(Str::random(5));
                } while (static::query()->where('poultry_code', $code)->exists());

                $poultry->poultry_code = $code;
            }

            // Initial stock is the starting current stock.
            $poultry->current_quantity = $poultry->initial_quantity;
        });
    }

    public function scopeActive(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('status', self::STATUS_ACTIVE);
    }

    public function scopeChickens(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('type', self::TYPE_CHICKEN);
    }

    public function scopeRoosters(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('type', self::TYPE_ROOSTER);
    }
}

SOURCE FILE: app\Models\User.php

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Database\Factories\UserFactory;
use Filament\Models\Contracts\FilamentUser;
use Filament\Panel;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Hidden;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;

#[Fillable([
    'name',
    'email',
    'password',
    'role',
    'is_active',
])]
#[Hidden(['password', 'remember_token'])]
class User extends Authenticatable implements FilamentUser
{
    /** @use HasFactory<UserFactory> */
    use HasFactory, Notifiable;

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'email_verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'password' => 'hashed',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
        ];
    }

    public function isAdmin(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === 'admin';
    }

    public function isActive(): bool
    {
        return $this->is_active;
    }

    public function canAccessPanel(Panel $panel): bool
    {
        return $this->isAdmin() && $this->isActive();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Providers\Filament;

use Filament\Http\Middleware\Authenticate;
use Filament\Http\Middleware\AuthenticateSession;
use Filament\Http\Middleware\DisableBladeIconComponents;
use Filament\Http\Middleware\DispatchServingFilamentEvent;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard;
use Filament\Panel;
use Filament\PanelProvider;
use Filament\Support\Colors\Color;
use Filament\Widgets\AccountWidget;
use Filament\Widgets\FilamentInfoWidget;
use Illuminate\Cookie\Middleware\AddQueuedCookiesToResponse;
use Illuminate\Cookie\Middleware\EncryptCookies;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\Middleware\PreventRequestForgery;
use Illuminate\Routing\Middleware\SubstituteBindings;
use Illuminate\Session\Middleware\StartSession;
use Illuminate\View\Middleware\ShareErrorsFromSession;

class AdminPanelProvider extends PanelProvider
{
    public function panel(Panel $panel): Panel
    {
        return $panel
            ->default()
            ->id('admin')
            ->path('admin')
            ->viteTheme('resources/css/filament/admin/theme.css')
            ->login()
            ->colors([
                'primary' => Color::Amber,
            ])
            ->discoverResources(in: app_path('Filament/Resources'), for: 'App\Filament\Resources')
            ->discoverPages(in: app_path('Filament/Pages'), for: 'App\Filament\Pages')
            ->pages([
                Dashboard::class,
            ])
            ->discoverWidgets(in: app_path('Filament/Widgets'), for: 'App\Filament\Widgets')
            ->widgets([
                AccountWidget::class,
                FilamentInfoWidget::class,
            ])
            ->middleware([
                EncryptCookies::class,
                AddQueuedCookiesToResponse::class,
                StartSession::class,
                AuthenticateSession::class,
                ShareErrorsFromSession::class,
                PreventRequestForgery::class,
                SubstituteBindings::class,
                DisableBladeIconComponents::class,
                DispatchServingFilamentEvent::class,
            ])
            ->authMiddleware([
                Authenticate::class,
            ]);
    }
}

    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the

    |

    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | If you have multiple user tables or models you may configure multiple
    | providers to represent the model / table. These providers may then
    | be assigned to any extra authentication guards you have defined.
    |

    |

        ],

        //     'driver' => 'database',
        //     'table' => 'users',
        // ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Resetting Passwords
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | These configuration options specify the behavior of Laravel's password
    | reset functionality, including the table utilized for token storage
    | and the user provider that is invoked to actually retrieve users.
    |
    | The expiry time is the number of minutes that each reset token will be
    | considered valid. This security feature keeps tokens short-lived so
    | they have less time to be guessed. You may change this as needed.
    |
    | The throttle setting is the number of seconds a user must wait before
    | generating more password reset tokens. This prevents the user from

    |
    */

    'passwords' => [

    |            "redis", "dynamodb", "array"
    |
    */

    'driver' => env('SESSION_DRIVER', 'database'),

    */

    */

    'table' => env('SESSION_TABLE', 'sessions'),

    /*

SOURCE FILE: database\factories\UserFactory.php

<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<User>
 */
class UserFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * The current password being used by the factory.
     */
    protected static ?string $password;

    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->name(),
            'email' => fake()->unique()->safeEmail(),
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'password' => static::$password ??= Hash::make('password'),
            'remember_token' => Str::random(10),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Indicate that the model's email address should be unverified.
     */
    public function unverified(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'email_verified_at' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

SOURCE FILE: tests\Feature\AdminAuthenticationTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Filament\Auth\Pages\Login;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AdminAuthenticationTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        filament()->setCurrentPanel('admin');
    }

    public function test_active_admin_can_login_with_valid_credentials(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'role' => 'admin',
            'is_active' => true,
            'password' => 'StrongPassword123!',
        ]);

        Livewire::test(Login::class)
            ->fillForm([
                'email' => $user->email,
                'password' => 'StrongPassword123!',
            ])
            ->call('authenticate')
            ->assertHasNoFormErrors();

        $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($user);
    }

    public function test_admin_cannot_login_with_invalid_password(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'role' => 'admin',
            'is_active' => true,
            'password' => 'StrongPassword123!',
        ]);

        Livewire::test(Login::class)
            ->fillForm([
                'email' => $user->email,
                'password' => 'WrongPassword123!',
            ])
            ->call('authenticate')
            ->assertHasFormErrors(['data.email']);

        $this->assertGuest();
    }

    public function test_staff_cannot_login_to_admin_panel(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'role' => 'staff',
            'is_active' => true,
            'password' => 'StrongPassword123!',
        ]);

        Livewire::test(Login::class)
            ->fillForm([
                'email' => $user->email,
                'password' => 'StrongPassword123!',
            ])
            ->call('authenticate')
            ->assertHasFormErrors(['data.email']);

        $this->assertGuest();
    }

    public function test_authenticated_admin_can_logout(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'role' => 'admin',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($user);

        $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($user);

        $this->post('/admin/logout');

        $this->assertGuest();
    }

    public function test_guest_cannot_access_admin_dashboard(): void
    {
        $this->get('/admin')
            ->assertRedirect('/admin/login');

        $this->assertGuest();
    }
}

SOURCE FILE: tests\Feature\UserAuthorizationTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Filament\Facades\Filament;
use Tests\TestCase;

class UserAuthorizationTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_active_admin_can_access_panel(): void
    {
        $user = new User([
            'role' => 'admin',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        $panel = Filament::getPanel('admin');

        $this->assertTrue($user->canAccessPanel($panel));
    }

    public function test_manager_cannot_access_admin_panel(): void
    {
        $user = new User([
            'role' => 'manager',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        $panel = Filament::getPanel('admin');

        $this->assertFalse($user->canAccessPanel($panel));
    }

    public function test_inactive_admin_cannot_access_panel(): void
    {
        $user = new User([
            'role' => 'admin',
            'is_active' => false,
        ]);

        $panel = Filament::getPanel('admin');

        $this->assertFalse($user->canAccessPanel($panel));
    }

    public function test_staff_cannot_access_admin_panel(): void
    {
        $user = new User([
            'role' => 'staff',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        $panel = Filament::getPanel('admin');

        $this->assertFalse($user->canAccessPanel($panel));
    }
}
